description: Send one exact value to a Thalovant hub using a saved identity: something typed, scanned, a barcode, a QR code or a serial number. The hub receives it as an utterance whose input is marked exact, and a skill that recognizes the value may act on it. Returns once the value is sent, without waiting for a reply. THALOVANT_MCP_READONLY leaves this tool out.

configPath.description: Path to a Thalovant SDK config file.

fromEnv.description: Load the identity from Thalovant SDK environment variables.

identityFile.description: Path to a Thalovant identity JSON file.

kind.description: What the value is, such as barcode, qr or serial. Defaults to code.

label.description: A label carried with the value in its context (input.label).

value.description: The value exactly as read; only leading and trailing spaces are trimmed.

name: thalovant_send_code
title: Send Code
